items.title: Chester Zardis Interview, 1966-03-09
items.q: Even Hubert Moran, he started on that style.

ctx.x: Make all that, oh man. Oh Buddy, boy that boy's been something. Did he use mutes much? Yeah, he used a mute, not too much a mute. But he'd take that derby and use that derby a whole lot though. Well after he started using that derby, that's what made that derby famous around here. You take Chris Kelly and Rene. Well after Buddy died, well all them trumpet players start taking that derby. Even Hubert Moran, he started on that style. You know what I mean? He started making the note. Well they made it so that was it.
How did Buddy compare say with Kid Rene? I mean were there styles anything the same or different?

items.title: Herb Morand Interview, 1950-03-12
items.q: Yeah, Lowe Chester's artist, bass player. He's one of the great bass players of New Orleans.

ctx.x: Well, do you remember anyone else who was in your first band?
Yeah, Lowe Chester's artist, bass player. He's one of the great bass players of New Orleans. He's played with all the different bands. Buddy, Rene, Chris Kelly, and the different bands.
Well, do you remember any of the bands that were playing at the time when you first got interested in music?
